title: Southwesterly
summary: SOUTHWEST'ERLY, adjective 1. In the direction of southwest, or nearly so. 2. Coming from the southwest, or a point near it; as a southwesterly wind.

inlines.v: SOUTHWEST'ERLY, adjective 1. In the direction of southwest, or nearly so. 2. Coming from the southwest, or a point near it; as a southwesterly wind.
